- Skill name updated from "phy-prompt-diff" to "Prompt Diff".

- Updated author and organization metadata from "PHY041" to "Canlah AI" and added homepage URL.
- Bumped version to 1.0.1 in metadata.
- No behavioral, functional, or logic changes to the skill—documentation and metadata updates only.

Initial release — introduces semantic diffing for prompt and instruction files with detailed behavioral change analysis.

- Compares two versions of any prompt (SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, system prompt, etc.) and outputs a behavioral changelog.
- Identifies added, removed, softened, hardened, expanded, narrowed, moved, and rephrased instructions.
- Detects contradictions, guardrail removals, and permission expansions with automatic risk level tagging (Critical, High, Medium, Low).
- Measures instruction density and tone drift between versions.
- Works entirely locally with zero external APIs; plain text-based, fast, and privacy-safe.
- Offers commit-ready, structured changelog output triggered by intuitive phrases or simple commands.
